670993d401385c8ff0b50887fc419248b19a1471.summary: Blog post by Lukas Stefanko, with a video demo, on Android Clipper, a Trojan that replaces cryptocurrency wallet addresses copied to the clipboard with the attacker's address. The post says the first Android Clipper was found outside Google Play by Dr. Web in August 2018 and inside Google Play by ESET in February 2019.

67cf09802cdaf5f19447d7f8ddfac52ce688cd30.summary: Check Point Research reports on The Gentlemen, a ransomware-as-a-service group that emerged around mid-2025 and publicly claims over 320 victims, most infected in 2026. During an incident response, an affiliate tried to deploy the SystemBC proxy malware; Check Point observed its C2 server reaching a botnet of over 1,570 victims, mostly in the United States. The intrusion used Cobalt Strike, credential harvesting, Defender tampering, RDP and AnyDesk, then Group Policy to deploy multi-OS lockers that encrypt files and delete shadow copies and logs.
